method: Native source order and Unicode word tokenization as scripts/macula_lsg_compact.py. Manual maps use colon for translation and tilde for contextual attachment. Exact bank alternatives require unique contiguous source and French occurrence per evidence entry; all remain unreviewed and may conflict. No inference or nearest-token fill. Native Deut 13:1 maps to LSG 12:32; native 13:2–19 maps to LSG 13:1–18. Cross-chapter records require explicit handling at canonical rebuild; the existing compact script is chapter-local.
